title: STRANGE MINUTE · GTA 6 · SECRETS

lines.text: Never steal this car in GTA 6.
lines.say: Never steal this car in G.T.A. six.

lines.text: There's a cat inside. Players say it growls, then attacks you.
Climb the tallest tower in Vice City.
It takes about six minutes to reach the top.
Up there, a bird's nest. With one egg.
Throw that egg, and a secret cutscene plays.
Stuck on the water? A dog in goggles can ride up on a jet ski.
Hurt too many people, and Jason and Lucia change.
Reviewers say there's a point of no return.
Push it too far, and they end up arrested. Or wasted.
The strange part? Lucia doesn't start free. She starts in prison.
Or will you steal the car with the cat?
